name: Living Greater Cautery
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.9-block radius for 14 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 1.25 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Heals 3 ❤
• Regeneration: +1.5 ❤ every 2 s for 10 s
• Growth: up to 6 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
